models.reconstruction_note: The supplied Ling 3.2 Flash benchmark request did not complete: OpenRouter returned HTTP 429 (rate limit). The provided Ling-named annotated MP4 is byte-for-byte identical to the main annotated video, so it is not independent evidence of a Ling model response. The six event timestamps and labels below are reconstructed from the main inspection timeline, not returned by Ling. YOLO alignment (5/6) is inferred from the main annotation overlays; cross-model agreement (6/6) is an approximate same-event comparison against the two available NVIDIA model outputs. Latency (32.45s) is borrowed from the Ling run in the existing first-video demo, tokens (12,079 input + 1,120 output) are estimated, and $0.000000 cost is assumed for a free route rather than provider-reported. Consequently the 83.5/100 score and EST. BETTER rank are illustrative estimates and must not be presented as measured Ling performance.

evaluation_limitations: The actual Ling request in the supplied recording did not complete; its raw model output was unavailable due to HTTP 429.
The uploaded Ling-named annotated MP4 is byte-identical to the main annotated inspection MP4. It is used only to keep the playback timeline functional for the reconstructed view.
Ling observations and Ling score metrics are estimates reconstructed from the main annotated output and prior-demo baseline values; they must not be presented as measured Ling performance.
Precision, recall, F1 and mAP cannot be calculated without manually labelled ground truth and a defined matching protocol.
Model agreement does not establish correctness; the route designation and site rules require confirmation by site personnel.
